{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the data
print("Shape:", df.shape)
print("\nColumns:", df.columns.tolist())
print("\nFirst 5 rows:\n", df.head().to_string(index=False))
print("\nData types:\n", df.dtypes)
print("\nMissing values:\n", df.isnull().sum())

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("\nNumber of -1 values in customer_age:", (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check revenue format
print("\nUnique revenue values (first 10):", df['revenue'].unique()[:10])"}
